summary: Kelso Technologies, a TSX-listed, US-dollar-functional railroad equipment supplier, furnished a Form 6-K carrying its November 5, 2026 news release plus interim IFRS financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. No transaction was announced: Q3 revenue was $1,756,751, nine-month revenue $5,751,306, gross margin 30% quarterly and 33% year-to-date, with operating expenses before FX and share-based costs falling to $954,240. The filing is a routine periodic reporting package, not a special situation; watch commercial traction from the newly AAR-approved 2-inch angle valve (K2AV) into fiscal 2027.
